While acquiring Swift provides Corgi Loaf with an immediate, high-floor starter (C-AVI 81.3, 10 rushing TDs in 2026) during Barkley's hamstring injury rehab, surrendering a premium unslotted 2028 1st (D-AVI 79.3) alongside Barkley (D-AVI 85.2) creates an unacceptably heavy dynasty equity deficit. Corgi Loaf should revise the proposal to demand tight end Dallas Goedert in return—solving Corgi Loaf's Week 14 Trey McBride bye hole—or remove the 2028 1st pick entirely.
